name: The vault child
description: First kami Child, created by Iname, who became the first kami of flowers; killed by Iname.

timeline.summary: Jace shatters the pod and takes the sleeping infant from the vault.
timeline.quote: Jace scooped up the child in his arms, cradling it to his chest.

timeline.summary: Iname creates the first kami Child and becomes the kami of life.
timeline.quote: the first kami Child since the beginning of time was born
